scope: Finite actual GPU input-stream/compression and filtered query/direct-path capture; no appearance, full SKY-G, source quality, uniform numerical certificate or performance pass

query.operator: physical g=64*(dot(p-centre,U/V)/(2*Huv)+.5)+.5; floor/fract four neighbours, interpolate each retained ordinary tau at dot(p-centre,W)+Hw, average exp(-tau) and exp(-.25tau) separately
query.boundary: clear before -rawW-guardW or laterally beyond Huv+guard; otherwise invalidtap requests one bounded direct path; domainflag1/invalidframe or fallback request>=4096 returnsnegative invalid
query.direct: 512 uniform midpoint samples on finite half-voxel source ray-box intersection toward scene.sun.xyz; same packed field; separate quadrature from full-projection input stream

deep_product.privateState: O(1) scalar/vector state; compiler allocation/spills unmeasured
